title: Rafael and the Colony
author: Ulyana Crane
blurb: Kestrel Ashgrove, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
